content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD mixing.F: time-averaged (mean-flow / wave-statistics / radiation-stress) accumulation. MIXING_STUFF (L53-78) calls CALCULATE_MEAN once time >= STEADY_TIME (L60-61); the old long argument list is kept as comments (L63-74). CALCULATE_MEAN (L108-305, all state from USE GLOBAL L109; the pre-refactor dummy-argument declarations are commented out L113-141) advances T_sum=T_sum+DT (L143) and branches on IF(T_sum.GE.T_INTV_mean) (L144). Finalize branch (L146-259): adds the last increment to running sums - ETA2sum from (Eta-ETAmean)^2*DT (L146) with ETA2mean=ETA2sum/T_sum (L147), Usum/Vsum/ETAsum (L149-151) giving Umean/Vmean/ETAmean (L152-154), depth-averaged U_davg_sum/V_davg_sum, flux P_sum/Q_sum (L156-159), covariance sums UUsum/UVsum/VVsum weighted by total depth (Eta-ETAmean+Depth) (L160-162), WWsum=0.25*Wsurf^2*(depth)*DT (L163), friction FRCXsum/FRCYsum=U*sqrt(U^2+V^2)*DT (L164-165), breaking dissipation BreakDissX_sum/BreakDissY_sum from BreakSourceX/Y (L166-167); then all means = sums/T_sum (L169-180). Radiation-stress gradient terms are computed on interior cells (L183-216) with central differences over 2*DXg/2*DYg and hardcoded gravity 9.80: DxSxx (L185-187, includes -WWmean gradient and +0.5*9.80*ETA2mean gradient), DySxy (L188), DySyy (L189-191), DxSxy (L192), pressure gradients PgrdX/PgrdY = 9.80*(Depth+ETAmean)*d(ETAmean) (L193-196), advective flux gradients DxUUH (L197-200), DyUVH (L201-204), DyVVH (L205-208), DxUVH (L209-212) using P_mean^2/Q_mean products over Max(Depth+ETAmean,MinDepthFrc); FRCXmean/FRCYmean are multiplied by Cd (L213-214). Then T_sum is decremented by T_INTV_mean rather than zeroed (L224, comment 'T_sum=ZERO? (ykchoi)') and all sums reset to ZERO (L225-242); SigWaveHeight=4.004*SQRT(ETA2mean) (L244); wave-height statistics WaveHeightAve=HavgSum/Num_Zero_Up and WaveHeightRMS=SQRT(HrmsSum/Num_Zero_Up) where Num_Zero_Up>=2 (L247-257, per-interval resets are commented out L253-255); CALL PREVIEW_MEAN outputs the means (L259). Accumulation branch (ELSE L261-301): same sum updates each step (L263-281), plus zero-upcrossing wave detection per cell: track Emax/Emin (L286-287), detect upcrossing of the mean via Tmpe=Eta-ETAmean vs Tmp_0=Eta0-ETAmean with Tmpe>Tmp_0 and Tmpe*Tmp_0<=Zero (L288-290), increment Num_Zero_Up (L291), accumulate wave height H=Emax-Emin into HavgSum and (Emax-Emin)^2 into HrmsSum from the second crossing (L292-295), then reset Emax=-1000., Emin=1000. (L297-298).
entities: commented-out legacy dummy declarations of CALCULATE_MEAN argument version (L113-141)

unresolved: Cross-line: T_sum is decremented by T_INTV_mean (L224) instead of reset to ZERO while all sums are zeroed (L225-242); the residual T_sum carries into the next interval so subsequent means (sums/T_sum, L147-180) are normalized by a slightly larger denominator; the in-code comment L224 questions this.

Cross-line: in the finalize branch the means Umean/ETAmean etc. are computed (L152-154) only when T_sum crosses T_INTV_mean; UUsum increments (L160-162, L274-276) use U_davg_mean/ETAmean from the previous interval, which is intentional per comments L218-220 but means the first interval uses uninitialized/zero means.
Gravity is hardcoded as 9.80 in radiation-stress and pressure-gradient terms (L187, L191, L193, L195) instead of the GRAV parameter used elsewhere in the code base.

Per-interval resets of Num_Zero_Up/HavgSum/HrmsSum are commented out (L253-255), so WaveHeightAve/WaveHeightRMS (L250-251) are cumulative over the whole run since STEADY_TIME, not per averaging window.

MIXING_STUFF header says it computes Smagorinsky-mixing-related means (L47, L57) but comment L58-59 (ykchoi) notes Umean/Vmean may not be used by other routines; actual consumers are outside this file.

Variables T_sum, T_INTV_mean, ETA2sum, U_davg, P_center, BreakSourceX/Y, ZERO, Emax/Emin, Num_Zero_Up, HavgSum/HrmsSum etc. all come from USE GLOBAL (L109); their declarations/initial values are external to this file.
